blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 EPFO Launches 'VISHWAS 2026' One-Time Penalty & Damages Dispute Resolution Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Operational for 6 months to settle Sec 14B EPF penalty disputes with reduced damages.
Dispute Settlement: One-time resolution scheme for penalty disputes under Sec 14B EPF Act 1952 and Sec 128 Code on Social Security 2020.
Reduced Damages Scale: Defaults before June 14, 2024 get reduced damages of 0.25%/month (up to 2 months), 0.50%/month (2-4 months), and 1%/month (>4 months).
VISHWAS 2026 scheme duration (6 months) vs default cutoff date (June 14, 2024).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on 8.25% annual interest rate, Central Board of Trustees (CBT) decision, and wage ceiling limit (₹15,000).
